purpose: The live-book run log. Real, live-quoted contracts discovered with yfinance, not invented. The opening legs were picked on 2026-09-17 at >=35 DTE; each leg is held to expiry and then rolled by roll_rule.
sizing_rule: 1 contract (multiplier 100) per leg, uniformly, across all 8 legs. Underlyings range from $2 (PLUG) to $754 (SPY), so this is not equal notional exposure -- it is the simplest defensible rule (no leg is deliberately over- or under-sized relative to the others by contract count) and matches how a small paper book is naturally sized. Per-leg PnL, not book-level notional-weighted PnL, is the reported unit throughout.
roll_rule: Hold each leg to expiry. The run that settles a leg (intrinsic value at the expiry close) replaces it with the same leg_id on a new contract opened at that run's session close: the first standard monthly expiry (third Friday) at least 35 days out, and the two-sided-quoted strike nearest target_strike_to_spot x spot. target_strike_to_spot is the leg's strike / spot when first picked and is never re-fit. For the opening legs spot_at_pick is the 2026-09-16 close, the spot the 2026-09-17 pick saw (the leg notes call it the 2026-09-17 spot). Code: evals/live_book/roll.py.
